extracted.intended_audience: Individuals and organizations seeking to work with the Asian Development Bank (job seekers, consultants, contractors and suppliers, governments and executing/implementing agencies, development institutions, private sector partners, civil society/NGOs, and investors).
extracted.subtask_description: High-level guidance on the ways to engage and do business with the Asian Development Bank: employment, consulting and procurement opportunities, and investor relations including bond programs. The page lists the types of partners ADB works with and where to find opportunities and further information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Careers at ADB
rubrics_metrics.description: Work with us to solve the region’s complex challenges and deliver development solutions that support sustainable, inclusive, and resilient growth.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sections / items listed: Latest Vacancies; What We Seek; Salary and Benefits; Respectful Workplace; FAQs: ADB Careers. Note: Career opportunities published outside of the official careers site may be inaccurate or unauthorized—visit www.adb.org/careers for verified and up-to-date details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Business Center guidance for firms and individuals
rubrics_metrics.description: The ADB Business Center provides guidance for individuals and companies seeking consulting, project procurement and other business opportunities with ADB.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Target audiences explicitly listed: Consultants; Contractors and Suppliers; Governments; Executing and Implementing Agencies; Development Institutions; Private Sector Partners; Civil Society/Non-government Organizations. Related topics: Procurement and Outreach; Project Procurement; Institutional Procurement; Business Opportunities Outreach; Projects & Tenders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Operational Procurement
rubrics_metrics.description: ADB extends loans and provides technical assistance to its developing member countries for a broad range of development projects and programs involving the procurement of goods, works, and services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operational procurement is the mechanism by which project-financed goods/works/services are procured in developing member countries as part of ADB-financed projects and technical assistance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institutional Procurement
rubrics_metrics.description: ADB procures goods, works, and services necessary for institutional use in its headquarters and field offices to support its operations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Institutional procurement covers purchases made to run ADB itself (HQ and field offices). The page points to 'Latest procurement notices' for institutional procurements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Projects & Tenders (project procurement notices)
rubrics_metrics.description: List of ongoing and future procurement of goods, works, non-consulting, and consulting services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Projects & Tenders section to find procurement notices and opportunities tied to ADB-financed projects. This is the primary place for firms to see open and upcoming procurements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investor Relations / Bond Issuance
rubrics_metrics.description: ADB is a leading triple-A borrower that raises funds regularly through bond issues in international and domestic capital markets, reflecting strong credit fundamentals and conservative financial policies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Investor Relations provides information for investors; ADB's credit standing and bond issuance practices are central to working with ADB as an investor or in capital markets.

rubrics_metrics.name: ADB Green Bonds
rubrics_metrics.description: The Green Bond program enables ADB to support its developing member countries seeking to mitigate greenhouse gas emissions and adapt to the consequences of climate change, whilst delivering environmentally sustainable growth to help reduce poverty and improve the quality of life of their people.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Green Bonds are targeted financing instruments for climate mitigation and adaptation projects; this program channels investor funds toward environmentally sustainable development activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: ADB Theme Bonds for Sustainable Development
rubrics_metrics.description: Theme bond offerings include health, gender, and education bonds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects funded by theme bonds are aligned with the UN’s Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) on quality education, gender equality, clean water and sanitation, and good health. Theme bonds allow investors to support specific SDG-aligned sectors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diversity and organizational mission messaging
rubrics_metrics.description: ADB emphasizes diversity (employees from more than 60 countries) and invites people to share knowledge and skills to be part of the vision for prosperous, inclusive, resilient, and sustainable Asia and the Pacific.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This messaging sets expectations for the organizational culture and mission alignment sought from prospective employees and partners: commitment to sustainability, inclusion, resilience, and regional development impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Warning about unauthorized career postings / verification practice
rubrics_metrics.description: Career opportunities published outside of ADB's official careers site may be inaccurate or listed by unauthorized third parties.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical instruction: for verified and most up-to-date details, use www.adb.org/careers to avoid scams or misinformation.
